title: Fairy Tail Creator Returns With a Brand New Blue Lock Crossover
content: Hiro Mashima is one of the most celebrated manga creators of all time, known for creating several incredible series, including Fairy Tail . The beloved manga was serialized in Kodansha’s Weekly Shonen Magazine from 2006 to 2017, and even won the prestigious Kodansha Manga Award in the Shonen category in 2009.
